title: Settlement of an Event Bill by the Client
content:
A client holding a Private Event & Banquet Services agreement may settle an event bill raised against it. What the desk settles on such a request is the amount that bill is to be met with, and the payment is then recorded against the single bill it settles, the account's unsettled event balance falling by what was paid.

## When the amount is fixed

The amount an event bill is settled with is fixed only after the event ledger carries the final bill for that booking, with the amount billed and the bill reference the payment settles.

Equally: for so long as no final bill for that booking stands in the agreement's event ledger — none carrying an amount billed and a bill reference — there is no fixed amount for the client to settle and no bill reference for a payment to name.

## How the settlement is made

The tool `settle_event_bill_79f0663f` is unlocked and handed over to be run by the customer themselves, the client organisation's own contact, rather than run at the desk. One call records a single payment entry into the event ledger of the agreement the bill sits under, carrying the bill being settled, the booking it concerns, the amount paid, how the money moved, and today as the day the money cleared.

## The values it is given

| Value | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `banquet_agreement_id` | The reference number of the private event and banquet services agreement the bill sits under, as the agreement lookup returns it. |
| `customer_id` | The reference number of the client organisation profile paying, as the profile lookup returns it. |
| `booking_reference` | The event booking the payment is allocated to, written as BQ- followed by 6 digits, exactly as it stands on the booking entry in the event ledger. |
| `invoice_reference` | The single bill being settled, written as INV-BQ- followed by 6 digits, exactly as it is printed on that bill. |
| `payment_amount_usd` | The amount the client pays, in USD, to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent at the moment it is recorded, a half-cent going to the nearer even cent, and never left blank. |
| `payment_channel` | How the money moves, one of exactly these values: `ach` where the client sends the money by bank transfer from their own account; `check` where the client posts a cheque drawn on the client organisation; `corporate_card` where the client puts the payment on a company card over the telephone; `internal_transfer` where the money is moved between balances already held on the client's own records rather than received from outside; `not_applicable` where no money changes hands at all. |

## What comes back

A confirmation line of text naming the payment entry reference minted for the settlement, the bill reference settled, the booking it was allocated to, the amount received in USD to two decimal places, how the money moved, and the day it cleared, written as YYYY-MM-DD. The line being returned is what indicates the payment was recorded; the entry is then visible on the agreement's event ledger.
